BackstoryDef.title: unlicensed pharmacist
BackstoryDef.description: During their descent into the grey planet, [PAWN_nameDef] encountered a mini-barrel full of fentanyl and decided for some reason to chug it. \nHaving somehow survived the experience, [PAWN_pronoun] used this knowledge to dillute opioids for an unchipped settlement.

BackstoryDef.title: elder thornback slayer
BackstoryDef.description: For one overgrown depths colony, [PAWN_nameDef] was the one everyone relied on to protect the colony from the native Elder Thornbacks.

BackstoryDef.title: traumatized survivor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s time spent on the grey planet has left them mentally scarred. While [PAWN_pronoun] has gained various survival skills, [PAWN_pronoun] will collapse when under pain.

BackstoryDef.title: subsurface vulture
BackstoryDef.description: Plunged into the dried desert, food that wouldn't kill [PAWN_objective] was difficult to find. What was plentiful, however, were the bodies of the sawians that came before [PAWN_possessive]. \nIn desperation, [PAWN_nameDef] resorted to consuming the corpses that littered the land... and didn't stop when given normal food.

BackstoryDef.title: gravel dweller
BackstoryDef.description: After escaping with the others to the Rim, [PAWN_nameDef] realized something. After years of torment by scientists on the surface, [PAWN_pronoun] liked it in the caves. For the first time in [PAWN_possessive] life, [PAWN_pronoun] was right where [PAWN_pronoun] was supposed to be.

BackstoryDef.title: haunted survivor
BackstoryDef.description: Despite being stuck in the same situation, not all sawians were open to cooperation. [PAWN_nameDef] found out the hard way when a conversation with a Trader went out. \n[PAWN_nameDef] came out on top, but [PAWN_pronoun] will never be able to forget the screams of the Trader.

BackstoryDef.title: pyro landscaper
BackstoryDef.description: Trapped within the Overgrown Depths, [PAWN_nameDef] was sure [PAWN_possessive] life was over when [PAWN_pronoun] got surrounded by thornbacks. However, by chance, [PAWN_nameDef] managed to start a fire which swarmed the caves and the thornbacks. \nManaging to escape the burning cave, [PAWN_nameDef] was forever changed by this experience. Fire is the path to salvation.

BackstoryDef.title: cereal trader
BackstoryDef.description: Without any personal aspirations, [PAWN_nameDef] stuck to the cargo mission, until [PAWN_pronoun] encountered a large stash of cereal and milk. Smittened by its taste, [PAWN_nameDef] switched [PAWN_possessive] plans to focus on distributing cereal to as many sawians as possible.

BackstoryDef.title: trap defuser
BackstoryDef.description: During [PAWN_nameDef] stay on the grey planet, [PAWN_pronoun] made it [PAWN_possessive] mission to disarm as many traps as [PAWN_pronoun] could to make transit in the planet as safe as possible.

BackstoryDef.title: cave artist
BackstoryDef.description: Having discovered that glowfruit can be crushed into an ink, [PAWN_nameDef] decided to draw out [PAWN_possessive] thoughts onto scrap paper. \n[PAWN_nameDef] was unable to hold onto [PAWN_possessive] artwork, but [PAWN_pronoun] hopes that others found them during their descent.

BackstoryDef.title: natural born asshole
BackstoryDef.description: Despite [PAWN_nameDef]'s best efforts, [PAWN_pronoun] is unable to keep [PAWN_possessive] thoughts to [PAWN_possessive]self. \nDue to this, [PAWN_nameDef] has found that others will actively refuse to work with [PAWN_objective], leading to [PAWN_nameDef] learning how to survive on [PAWN_possessive] own.

BackstoryDef.title: wandering herbalist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] after being deployed onto the Grey Planet discovered that [PAWN_pronoun] has a nack for creating medicines and treatments using the natural fauna. \nTo best use this knowledge, [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] time dedicated to wandering around the layers providing aid to any sawians [PAWN_pronoun] encountered.

BackstoryDef.title: loot goblin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s greed knows no bounds. While the local colonies appreciated the high-quality medical loot [PAWN_nameDef] brings in, they would rather [PAWN_pronoun] decide to not attempt to squeeze through tiny gaps to reach a create.

BackstoryDef.title: adrenaline junkie
BackstoryDef.description: Before being rescued by an unchipped colony, [PAWN_nameDef] would always take their time traveling down the layers. This behavior meant that the Punishment Protocol line was never far from [PAWN_nameDef]. \nWhile [PAWN_nameDef] no longer has the line following them, [PAWN_pronoun] still claims to taste a bit of metal in [PAWN_possessive] mouth.

BackstoryDef.title: oil harvester
BackstoryDef.description: Down in the Dried Desert layer, [PAWN_nameDef] manages a little pump setup which extracts the spilled oil littered across the biome. \nWhile buisness was slow at first, couriers soon came by the many, all affilated with the "Interplanetary Escape Project".

BackstoryDef.title: toxirock sweeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s time spent on the Grey Planet primarily consisted of clearing out patches of Toxirocks for the colonies down in the Wastelands. \nDespite the fact that many sawians fell gravely ill doing this work, [PAWN_nameDef] seems completely unbothered by the radiation.

BackstoryDef.title: surface scout
BackstoryDef.description: Despite the dangers of being close to the surface, someone was needed to survey the surface of the Grey Planet, observing the ships from The Company™ and chart the orbital path of the nearby Rimworld.

BackstoryDef.title: sap collector
BackstoryDef.description: Down in the Overgrown Depths, [PAWN_nameDef] made a living collecting tree sap from the various underground trees. The sap would then be transported by others to colonies on the layer and beyond.

BackstoryDef.title: wild popfruit farmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] time on the Grey Planet collecting popfruit and helluce from the various patches of Pop that was growing around [PAWN_possessive] shelter.

BackstoryDef.title: arms collector
BackstoryDef.description: If there was something always in high-demand, it would be firearms. [PAWN_nameDef] decided to capitalize on this opportunity by seeking out caches of human' vaults for collection of firearms and ammunition. \nAlong the way, [PAWN_nameDef] also gained a proficiency in shooting.

BackstoryDef.title: guilty soldier
BackstoryDef.description: Despite being a corporate soldier from The Company™, [PAWN_nameDef] was accepted with open arms into the colony. \nHowever, despite protests from others, [PAWN_pronoun] is unable to shake the guilt of [PAWN_possessive] actions and refuses any niceties from [PAWN_possessive] fellow colonists.

BackstoryDef.title: colony unchipper
BackstoryDef.description: Being chipped is a death sentence for anyone who chooses to abandoned the cargo mission. Fortunately, [PAWN_nameDef] was brave and skilled enough to attempt to remove the brain chips. \nWhile not every operation was successful, [PAWN_nameDef]'s resolve and determination to save as many as [PAWN_pronoun] could.

BackstoryDef.title: colony leader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a leader of a colony involved in the 'Interplanetary Escape Project'. Managing the needs of the colony and ensuring the project remains on track while neccesary has taken its toll on [PAWN_possessive] psyche.

BackstoryDef.title: colony courier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a courier who swiftly traversed from colony to colony. Carrying critical medical supplies and plans for the 'Interplanetary Escape Project' has given [PAWN_nameDef] unparalleled agility, but at the cost of [PAWN_pronoun] physical toughness.

BackstoryDef.title: cave farmer
BackstoryDef.description: In [PAWN_nameDef]'s colony, [PAWN_pronoun] was entrusted with cultivating the colony various plants like, glowplant, hydreed, stoneplant, etc.\n\nWhile the rimworld natural fauna is different from those of the grey planet, [PAWN_nameDef] has had an easy time adopting to the new crops.

BackstoryDef.title: colony builder
BackstoryDef.description: Tearing down life pods, and dismantling old structures with [PAWN_possessive] plasma cutter, [PAWN_nameDef] spent a significant amount of [PAWN_possessive] time building shelters and other buildings at [PAWN_possessive] colony.

BackstoryDef.title: cave engineer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was in charge of cave shoring for [PAWN_possessive] colony.

BackstoryDef.title: perimeter guard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] job was to help maintain the security around the many entry points into [PAWN_possessive] colony. \nWhile basic combat skills helped against the occasional shade crawler and sand stalker, dealing with fellow sawians required the skill to decern between an expie that needed help or was a scout from a corporate raid party.

BackstoryDef.title: torchbearer
BackstoryDef.description: To hold leverage against The Company™, it was decided that The Cargo was to be hidden somewhere on the Rimworld. [PAWN_nameDef] was choosen to be one of the few sawians who knew part of intel needed to locate where The Cargo is located.

BackstoryDef.title: shade crawler wrangler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s colony suffered from being located nearby a shade crawler nest. To prevent the shade crawlers from infiltrating the colony, [PAWN_nameDef] made it [PAWN_possessive] life to wrangle the shade crawlers. Utilizing its natural cowardice to keep them at bay.
